Neural Intelligence Engine

The Aura Neural Architecture

Nora is not just another wrapper. We operate a hybrid intelligence architecture combining our dedicated on-premise Aura V10 engine with multi-modal cloud inference.

NORA CORE ENGINE

Aura V10 (Local)

Our fine-tuned 1.8B parameter engine operating directly on dedicated bare-metal hardware for ultra-low latency.

  • Absolute Privacy: Zero cloud telemetry or third-party logging.
  • Sub-100ms Inference: Lightning response cycles on Discord chat.
  • Domain Specialization: Trained on Discord moderation heuristics.
  • Bare-Metal Safety: Offline fault-tolerant execution.
MULTIMODAL VISION

Gemini 1.5 Flash

High-throughput cloud engine utilized for massive context windows, document synthesis, and visual media analysis.

  • Deep screenshot & image OCR threat parsing.
  • 1M+ token context window for prolonged guild history.
  • High-speed general knowledge verification.
  • Adaptive fallback for complex analytical queries.
LOGICAL REASONING

GPT-4o Mini

Analytical engine engaged for multi-turn conversational reasoning, roleplay adherence, and complex rule evaluation.

  • High-precision contextual classification and sentiment analysis.
  • Strict persona alignment for custom bot personalities.
  • Advanced rule parsing for automated support tickets.
